Action: Agree priority audience, actual services and service area.
Definition of done: A one-page brief with one primary buyer and three recurring questions.
Dependency: Do not use assumed service coverage or unverified credentials.

Action: Open the three slides and caption together on a phone. Send exact files for review.
Definition of done: CEO feedback recorded privately; spelling, formula and scope checked.
Dependency: Approval is not recorded in this desk.

Action: Use 01–03 in order. Preserve the limitation. No link or boost.
Definition of done: Published URL and final crop shared with Omar after approval.
Dependency: Only this organic post is allowed before the website is ready.

Action: Record the general questions and saves/shares at 24h and seven days.
Definition of done: One observation and one improvement; no invented reach target.
Dependency: Do not interpret one post as proof of a winning strategy.

Action: Provide approved team names, roles, headshots, licence details and permission to display them.
Definition of done: Verified evidence folder and approved descriptions, stored privately.
Dependency: Never invent certificates, testimonials or case outcomes.

Action: Test Arabic mobile reading, service links, enquiry form, inbox delivery and privacy flow.
Definition of done: Successful test evidence; correct article URLs and reliable submission event.
Dependency: Do not launch article-led posts or paid ads while this is unresolved.

Task: Make the Zakat article the anchor
Action: Check the existing article against sources and CEO feedback. Add a worked organisational example and useful service route.
Definition of done: Reviewed article with direct answer, limitations and working internal links.
Dependency: Do not present a file-organisation checklist as official filing requirements.

Task: Adapt the anchor for one channel
Action: Choose Instagram carousel or LinkedIn explanation based on the reader. Verify its exact article destination.
Definition of done: Final caption, numbered visuals, alt text and approved CTA.
Dependency: Website gate and content review must be cleared.

Action: Use a verified profile/Story route on Instagram or direct article link on LinkedIn.
Definition of done: Post URL, tagged external visits and useful questions recorded privately.
Dependency: A feed caption URL is not a dependable clickable route.

Action: Show two cover drafts to three willing colleagues; ask what lesson they expect.
Definition of done: Record paraphrased answers and choose the clearer cover.
Dependency: This is qualitative feedback, not a statistically valid split test.

Task: Build a source and expert habit
Action: Verify each tax claim and applicable scope. Ask the CEO to review the substantive example.
Definition of done: Claim, source, scope, reviewer and version recorded for the anchor.
Dependency: A competitor article is not a tax-law authority.

Action: Improve the existing guide with period/scope comparison and one concrete next action.
Definition of done: Reviewed article and distinct social lesson, without repeating the Zakat creative.
Dependency: The sample must not imply every mismatch is an error.

Action: Compare a question-led cover with a calculation-led cover across comparable approved posts.
Definition of done: A written hypothesis, fixed metric and one next decision.
Dependency: Organic comparisons have confounders; record them.

Action: Storyboard one approved lesson: question, demonstration, answer, limitation.
Definition of done: Reviewed spoken Arabic, on-screen text, shots and accessibility notes.
Dependency: No need to force a video if a static example teaches it better.

Action: Check current ZATCA sources, applicability and publication before sharing its link.
Definition of done: Live article passes mobile and link review; CEO approves its claims.
Dependency: Prepared URL does not equal a published page.

Action: Use Keyword Planner for the agreed region and language. Record demand ranges and cost estimates.
Definition of done: One tightly related keyword group, negatives and matching article.
Dependency: Do not treat our seed phrases as measured demand.

Action: Test one successful form submission, failed validation and reload. Inspect event counting and email receipt.
Definition of done: One real success fires once; failure and reload do not create false leads.
Dependency: Keep page reads and call clicks separate from confirmed enquiries.

Action: Separate media, production, subscriptions and taxes within the marketing allowance.
Definition of done: A written media cap, duration, stop conditions and monitoring owner.
Dependency: SAR100 total marketing is not automatically SAR100 ad spend.

Action: Use the lab, then inspect real settings in Ads: goal, location, terms, copy, URL and budget.
Definition of done: A reviewed draft ready for an explicit launch decision.
Dependency: Keep old campaigns paused; drafting does not authorize spend.

Action: Review content learning, article use, actual enquiries and any approved pilot costs.
Definition of done: Keep / revise / stop decisions with evidence and a next owner.
Dependency: More impressions alone do not justify a budget increase.
